items.title: Brandon Ingram, Bradley Beal, Max Strus, and Yanic Konan Niederhäuser are all making progress but will not be making the trip to Oklahoma City, the Clippers say.
items.author: Justin Russo
items.body_excerpt: Brandon Ingram, Bradley Beal, Max Strus, and Yanic Konan Niederhäuser are all making progress but will not be making the trip to Oklahoma City, the Clippers say.

items.title: Brandon Ingram and Yanic Konan Niederhäuser are doing court work but they won’t be ready to start the season, the Clippers say. Neither will Max  Strus or Bradley Beal. Kobe Sanders is out tonight but the team is optimistic he’ll be ready for Opening Night.

items.title: Clippers say Brandon Ingram, Bradley Beal, Kobe Sanders, and Yanic Konan Niederhäuser are doing individual player development work. Yanic and Ingram are out to start the season, Sanders is day to day, and Beal is managing inflammation.
